summary.intent: Move session ownership into the server-side session service.
behavioralChanges: The service rotates refresh credentials before returning a session.
architecturalImpact: Session state moves from the browser to the API boundary.
limitations: Runtime concurrency behavior was inferred and not executed.

stories.title: Session boundary
